stories_used.description: Stories the song covers, lead story first

status.description: fact_check.status copied from the news file

reason.description: Why the news reads this way

turn.description: The mid-song mood turn, or an empty string if there is none

hook.description: The hook lines in display form, used to avoid repeating hooks in later weeks

plan.description: The song as an ElevenLabs composition plan, following the formatting guide. This is the only place the lyrics are written.

text.description: Section label in square brackets, then the lyric lines (one bar per line), with short musical cues in curly braces

duration_ms.description: 3000 to 120000. All chunks together must not exceed the reel length.

positive_styles.description: English descriptors; at least 6 in the first chunk; no artist names

captions.description: On-screen captions in sung order, covering every lyric line of every chunk. No timestamps: they are measured from the audio.

section.description: Number of the plan chunk this caption belongs to, starting at 1

text.description: Display form: digits for numbers, 'Mu-Zueki' spelling, no cues or ad-libs. At most about 7 words.

sung.description: The same words exactly as written in the plan: numbers spelled out, 'Mew-Zookie' spelling

fact_map.description: One row per lyric line that states a number, name or event

line.description: The lyric line in display form

claim.description: The factual claim the line makes

rank.description: Rank of the story it comes from

source_text.description: A phrase copied character for character from that story's headline, summary or key_facts

opening_grab.description: What is heard and seen in the first second

caption_bar.description: The lyric line to feature on screen, quoted in display form

cut_points.description: Where visuals should cut, described by section and lyric line (not by timestamp)

post_caption.description: Names the week ("the week of October 26") and stories, includes 'Mu-Zueki', ends with 'Not financial advice.'

notes.description: What was revised and what is still weakest
